visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long black hair, wearing a pink yukata with white polka dots and a flower hairpiece, is seen sitting at a black grand piano in a side profile view. In the upper portion of the screen, a split-panel displays an anime-style illustration of a young woman with dark hair and purple eyes, who appears to be weeping with her hands over her mouth. The background of the lower frame consists of vertical grey fabric curtains under soft, bright studio lighting. (2) As the woman continues to play the piano, the top panel transitions to a different illustration showing a man in a blue yukata embracing a crying woman. The pianist's hands move gracefully across the keyboard, executing a melancholic melody. (3) The upper illustration shifts again to show the woman tenderly holding the face of a man with pink hair and blue facial markings. The pianist remains focused, her fingers pressing the keys with varying intensity to match the musical build-up. (4) The anime panel displays a close-up of the man's tear-filled eyes as a hand rests on his cheek. The pianist is shown from the torso up, her yukata sleeves moving with the motion of her arms as she plays more complex arpeggios. (5) The final illustration shows the two characters in a deep, sorrowful embrace. The pianist finishes the musical piece, her hands lifting slowly from the keys before she performs a small, respectful bow towards the camera.
